korean.swearWarningBody: These words sound very rude or aggressive in Korean. Do not repeat them — this list is only so you can recognize them if you hear them on the street, in media, or online.

transport.mapAlt: Full-screen interactive map of places in Korea
transport.mapCaption: Tap a pin to see the place intro here
transport.tabsHelp: Tap a tab to view details.
transport.subwayIntro: Each Seoul Metro line has its own color. Station names and transfer signs appear in Korean, English, Japanese, and Chinese. A T-money card is the easiest way to ride buses and the subway.
transport.officialMapDesc: For the most accurate official diagram, open Seoul Metro Cyber Station. Embedding it here is blocked by the site’s policy.
transport.interactiveMapHelp: Choose a line below to highlight it on the map. (Based on real routes — may look different from schematic maps.)
transport.mapSource: Satellite tiles: Esri · Coordinates: guidebook places
transport.linePickHint: Choose a line to highlight it on the map and show a short description below.
transport.subwayTip1: Buy and top up T-money at convenience stores or subway stations.
transport.subwayTip2: Rush hours (weekdays 7–9 a.m., 6–8 p.m.) are very crowded.
transport.subwayTip3: Use Kakao Map or Naver Map for live directions.
transport.line1Desc: A north–south line through Seoul Station, Jongno, and Dongdaemun. It also connects toward Incheon and Suwon.
transport.line1Stops: Key stops: Seoul Station · City Hall · Jonggak · Jongno 3-ga · Dongdaemun
transport.line2Desc: A loop line around Seoul. One of the most useful lines for travelers.
transport.line2Stops: Key stops: Hongik Univ. · City Hall · Dongdaemun History & Culture Park · Jamsil · Gangnam · Sadang
transport.line3Desc: Connects palaces, Apgujeong, and Express Bus Terminal. Handy for Gyeongbokgung and Anguk.
transport.line3Stops: Key stops: Gyeongbokgung · Anguk · Jongno 3-ga · Apgujeong · Express Bus Terminal · Gyodae
transport.line4Desc: Runs through Myeongdong, Seoul Station, and Hyehwa. Great for shopping and Namsan access.
transport.line4Stops: Key stops: Seoul Station · Myeongdong · Chungmuro · Hyehwa · Suyu · Sadang
transport.line5Desc: Crosses Yeouido, Gwanghwamun, and Dongdaemun, linking south and north of the Han River.
transport.line5Stops: Key stops: Yeouido · Gwanghwamun · Jongno 3-ga · Dongdaemun History & Culture Park · Wangsimni
transport.line6Desc: Serves Itaewon, Hannam, and Gongdeok—popular areas with many international visitors.
transport.line6Stops: Key stops: Gongdeok · Samgakji · Itaewon · Hangangjin · Yaksu · Dongmyo
transport.line7Desc: Links Express Bus Terminal, Konkuk Univ., and Nowon. Useful around Gangnam and Konkuk.
transport.line7Stops: Key stops: Express Bus Terminal · Nonhyeon · Gangnam-gu Office · Konkuk Univ. · Nowon
transport.line9Desc: Runs from Gimpo Airport through Yeouido and Sinnonhyeon, with express trains.
transport.line9Stops: Key stops: Gimpo Airport · Yeouido · Noryangjin · Sinnonhyeon · Bongeunsa · Sports Complex
transport.arexDesc: Connects Incheon Airport and Seoul Station. Express (~43 min) and all-stop (~60 min) trains are available.
transport.arexStops: Key stops: Incheon Airport T1/T2 · Hongik Univ. · Gongdeok · Seoul Station
transport.routeIntro: Step-by-step routes to popular places. Times vary with transfers and walking — double-check in Kakao Map or Naver Map before you go.
transport.route_amd_s1: From Incheon Airport T1/T2, follow signs for AREX to the underground platforms. Use elevators if you have a large suitcase.
transport.route_amd_s2: Buy/ride the All-Stop train (not Express unless you specifically want Seoul Station only). Express is pricier and skips most stops.
transport.route_amd_s3: Ride to Seoul Station (about 50–60 min). Watch the display for the next stops and get off at Seoul Station.
transport.route_ahd_s1: At Incheon Airport, find the AREX All-Stop platform (both terminals connect to AREX).
transport.route_ahd_s2: Ride to Hongik Univ. Station — no transfer, one of the easiest first-day routes.
transport.route_ahd_s3: Move toward the doors when Hongik Univ. appears on the display; stops are short.
transport.route_agn_s1: Take AREX All-Stop from the airport. Express only goes to Seoul Station, so All-Stop is usually better for Gangnam.
transport.route_agn_s2: Recommended: get off at Hongik Univ. → transfer to Line 2 toward Gangnam (check the board for direction).
transport.route_agn_s3: Line 2 is a loop — confirm you’re on the correct direction so Gangnam is upcoming.
transport.route_sgb_s1: Enter Seoul Station subway area (transfers from KTX/AREX can be a long walk).
transport.route_sgb_s2: Use your map app to Gyeongbokgung Station (Line 3). It will suggest the simplest transfer from Line 1/4.
transport.route_sgb_s3: Exit 5 is convenient for the palace / Gwanghwamun side — a few minutes on foot.
transport.route_mhd_s1: Board at Myeongdong (Line 4). Avoid rush hour if you have big shopping bags.
transport.route_mhd_s2: Example: Myeongdong → (Line 4) → Dongdaemun History & Culture Park → (Line 2) → Hongik Univ.
transport.route_mhd_s3: Another option transfers via City Hall to Line 2. Use the map app for the faster option that day.
transport.route_mgn_s1: From Myeongdong (Line 4), ride one stop to Chungmuro.
transport.route_mgn_s3: Ride to Gyodae, transfer to Line 2, then one stop to Gangnam.
transport.route_hit_s1: From Hongik Univ., head toward Gongdeuk (AREX/Line 2 options — check the app).
transport.route_hit_s3: Get off at Itaewon. Exits 1–4 are usually closest to the main street.
transport.route_amd_s4: Transfer to subway Line 4 (blue). Follow transfer signs; toward Sadang/Namtaeryeong is the Myeongdong direction.
transport.route_amd_s5: Get off at Myeongdong. Exits 6–8 are often best for the shopping street; confirm the recommended exit in your map app.
transport.route_amd_tip: Airport buses are an option with very heavy luggage. Keep big bags near the doors/luggage space on AREX.
transport.route_ahd_s4: Exits 9 and 1 are often closest to the main nightlife streets — check your hotel’s exit number.
transport.route_ahd_s5: Late at night the area is crowded and alleys are confusing; walking or a short taxi to your stay is fine.
transport.route_ahd_tip: Hongik Univ. is a big transfer hub (AREX / Line 2 / Gyeongui–Jungang). Wrong exits can add 10+ minutes.
transport.route_agn_s4: Get off at Gangnam. Exits 11–12 are famous for the main strip, but your hotel may need another exit.
transport.route_agn_s5: Alternatives: AREX to Seoul Station then bus, or an airport bus with a seat if you have lots of luggage.
transport.route_agn_tip: Line 2 around Gangnam is very crowded at rush hour. Keep suitcases by the doors, not in the aisle.
transport.route_sgb_s4: Check closed days (often Mondays) and ticket options before you go.
transport.route_sgb_s5: Bring a hat/umbrella for heat or rain while walking the grounds.
transport.route_sgb_tip: Hanbok rental is popular nearby. A small bag makes entry easier.
transport.route_mhd_s4: At Hongik Univ., pick the exit for Hongdae streets / Yeonnam-dong as needed.
transport.route_mhd_s5: Evenings are packed — meet friends by exit number.
transport.route_mhd_tip: It may feel walkable on a map, but the subway is usually faster and easier.
transport.route_mgn_s4: Exit using the map app’s recommendation for your exact destination.
transport.route_mgn_s5: Buses work too when traveling light, but subway is clearer for first-timers.
transport.route_mgn_tip: Chungmuro and Gyodae transfers are relatively short.
transport.route_hit_s4: Hills and alleys can be tiring with luggage — consider a short taxi at night.
transport.route_hit_s5: Weekends are crowded; keep valuables in front.
transport.route_hit_tip: Some routes transfer at Hapjeong — follow whichever the map says is faster live.
transport.placesIntro: Discover places on the map. A list is available for accessibility.
transport.place_myeongdong_desc: Seoul’s classic shopping and street-food district with duty-free stores.
transport.place_myeongdong_how: Line 4 Myeongdong Station. Exits 1 and 6–8 are closest to the main street.
transport.place_gyeongbok_desc: Joseon’s main palace — pair with hanbok rental and the palace museum.
transport.place_gyeongbok_how: Line 3 Gyeongbokgung Station exit 5. Also walkable from Gwanghwamun/Anguk.
transport.place_gangnam_desc: Shopping, cafés, nightlife — often includes Gangnam Station, Sinnonhyeon, Garosu-gil, Apgujeong.
transport.place_gangnam_how: Line 2 / Shinbundang Gangnam Station; exits 11–12 for the busy side.
transport.place_hongdae_desc: Youth culture, busking, cafés, clubs — especially lively at night.
transport.place_hongdae_how: Line 2 / AREX / Gyeongui–Jungang Hongik Univ. Station; exits 9 and 1.
transport.place_itaewon_desc: International food and bars; connects toward Haebangchon and Gyeongnidan.
transport.place_suwon_desc: UNESCO fortress walls and Hwaseong Haenggung palace.
transport.place_suwon_how: Line 1 Suwon Station then bus/taxi, or check Suin–Bundang walking routes.
transport.place_goyang_desc: Large park for cycling, picnics, and evening lights.
transport.place_goyang_how: Line 3 Madu / Jeongbalsan area — check lake-park exits on the map.
transport.place_gapyeong_desc: Nami Island and nearby day-trip spots in northeast Gyeonggi.
transport.place_gapyeong_how: Gyeongchun Line Gapyeong / Nami Island (Gyeonggang) Station; ITX also runs.
transport.place_haeundae_desc: Busan’s famous beach with Dongbaek Island and Marine City nearby.
transport.place_haeundae_how: Busan Metro Line 2 Haeundae Station; short walk or bus to the sand.
transport.place_nampo_desc: Jagalchi fish market, Gukje Market, and BIFF Square eats.
transport.place_seomyeon_desc: Busan’s central shopping and transfer hub.
transport.mapHelp: Tap a pin to zoom in. Use region chips to fly the camera.
transport.listHelp: Pick a place from the list to fly the map there.
transport.place_namsan_desc: Seoul’s classic skyline view — N Seoul Tower, cable car, and Namsan trails.
transport.place_namsan_how: Line 3/4 Chungmuro or Line 4 Myeongdong, then Namsan bus or cable car; walking paths exist too.
transport.place_bukchon_desc: Hanok alley photo spots between the palaces — links to Gyeongbokgung and Insadong.
transport.place_bukchon_how: Line 3 Anguk Station exit 2. It is a residential area — keep quiet and stay on public paths.
transport.place_insadong_desc: Traditional crafts, souvenirs, and tea houses — a top cultural shopping street for visitors.
transport.place_insadong_how: Line 3 Anguk Station exit 6, or Lines 1/3/5 Jongno 3-ga Station.
transport.place_dongdaemun_desc: Dongdaemun Design Plaza plus shopping and night markets — architecture and fashion hub.
transport.place_dongdaemun_how: Lines 2/4/5 Dongdaemun History & Culture Park Station; exits 1–2 toward DDP.
transport.place_lotte-tower_desc: Seoul Sky observatory, Lotte World Mall, and Seokchon Lake — views and shopping in one spot.
transport.place_lotte-tower_how: Lines 2 & 8 Jamsil Station; follow linked passages into the tower and mall.
transport.place_songdo_desc: Incheon’s canal-side skyline park — popular for walks, boats, and evening views.
transport.place_songdo_how: Incheon Metro Line 1 Central Park Station. From Seoul, transfer via AREX/subway.
transport.place_seoraksan_desc: Gangwon’s iconic national park — cable car, Ulsanbawi, and autumn colors on classic trips.
transport.place_seoraksan_how: Bus or taxi from Sokcho/Yangyang. From Seoul, express bus or rental car is common.
transport.place_bulguksa_desc: UNESCO temple and the heart of Gyeongju trips — often paired with Seokguram Grotto.
transport.place_bulguksa_how: City bus or taxi from Gyeongju Station/terminal; continue to Seokguram by shuttle/taxi.
transport.place_donggung_desc: Gyeongju’s night-photo classic — palace ruins reflected in the illuminated pond.
transport.place_donggung_how: Central Gyeongju; bus/taxi from the station or terminal. Near Hwangnidan-gil.
transport.place_jeonju_desc: Hanok streets, bibimbap, and hanbok — a classic overnight or day trip for visitors.
transport.place_jeonju_how: Taxi/bus from Jeonju Station or express bus terminal; KTX links Seoul and Busan.
transport.place_seongsan_desc: UNESCO volcanic tuff cone — Jeju’s east-coast sunrise and hiking icon.
transport.place_seongsan_how: Bus, rental car, or taxi from Jeju Airport / Jeju City; often paired with Udo Island.
transport.place_jungmun_desc: Jeju’s southern resort belt — Jungmun complex, waterfalls, and coastal walks.
transport.place_jungmun_how: A rental car is easiest; buses and taxis also run from the airport and Jeju City.
transport.place_gamcheon_desc: Colorful hillside village — one of Busan’s most visited photo spots for foreigners.
transport.place_gamcheon_how: Line 1 Toseong Station then village bus/taxi. Wear comfortable shoes for steep alleys.
transport.place_haedong_desc: Cliffside seaside temple — a classic east-Busan stop with Haeundae/Gijang.
transport.place_haedong_how: Bus or taxi from Haeundae or Gijang. Allow extra time for stairs and crowds.
transport.place_imjingak_desc: Gateway area for DMZ/Panmunjom tourism — tours, memorials, and viewpoints.
transport.place_imjingak_how: Gyeongui–Jungang Line Munsan Station then bus/taxi. Panmunjom tours need advance booking and passport.
transport.place_everland_desc: Korea’s flagship theme park — a popular day trip for families and international visitors.
transport.place_everland_how: From Bundang Line Jukjeon/Giheung etc. use Everline, shuttle, or bus — check live transfers.
transport.infoBadge: Useful visitor info (not a sightseeing pin)

apps.kakaoDesc: Strong for directions, transit, and taxis. Shop info is usually accurate because locals use it heavily.
apps.naverDesc: Detailed subway/bus transfers and live arrivals. Great walking routes too.
apps.papagoDesc: Korean↔English/Japanese translation plus photo text recognition — perfect for menus.
apps.talkDesc: Korea’s main messenger. Needed for hotels, tours, and adding local contacts.
apps.yanoljaDesc: Hotels, motels, and guesthouses with frequent same-day deals.
apps.yeogiDesc: Easy stay comparison and reviews. Photos and maps help even if the UI is Korean.
apps.coupangDesc: Groceries and food delivery. Often accepts foreign cards — handy for short stays.
apps.baeminDesc: Korea’s most popular food delivery app. The UI is Korean, but photos and maps make ordering easy — great for hotel delivery on short trips.
apps.yogiyoDesc: Another major delivery app alongside Baemin. Shops and coupons differ — worth comparing both.
apps.tmoneyDesc: Check transit card balance/top-up and some mobility services in one app.
apps.kakaoTDesc: Taxis, designated drivers, bikes, and parking in one app. Foreign cards are often accepted.

kakaoBody.ko: 길찾기·대중교통·택시 호출에 강합니다. 한국인 사용률이 높아 가게 정보도 잘 맞습니다.
kakaoBody.en: Strong for directions, transit, and taxis. Shop info is usually accurate because locals use it heavily.
kakaoBody.ja: 経路・公共交通・タクシーに強いです。現地の人の利用が多く店舗情報も正確めです。

naverBody.ko: 지하철·버스 환승 안내가 자세합니다. 실시간 도착 정보와 도보 경로도 편리합니다.
naverBody.en: Detailed subway/bus transfers and live arrivals. Great walking routes too.
naverBody.ja: 地下鉄・バス乗換が詳しく、到着案内や徒歩ルートも便利です。

papagoBody.ko: 한국어↔영어·일본어 번역과 사진 속 글자 인식이 유용합니다. 메뉴판 번역에 좋아요.
papagoBody.en: Korean↔English/Japanese translation plus photo text recognition — perfect for menus.
papagoBody.ja: 韓↔英・日の翻訳と写真文字認識が便利。メニュー翻訳におすすめです。

kakaotalkBody.ko: 한국에서 가장 많이 쓰는 메신저입니다. 숙소·투어 연락, 친구 추가에 필요합니다.
kakaotalkBody.en: Korea’s main messenger. Needed for hotels, tours, and adding local contacts.
kakaotalkBody.ja: 韓国で最も使われるメッセンジャー。宿やツアー連絡に必要です。

yanoljaBody.ko: 호텔·모텔·게스트하우스 검색·예약. 당일 특가도 자주 있습니다.
yanoljaBody.en: Hotels, motels, and guesthouses with frequent same-day deals.
yanoljaBody.ja: ホテル・モテル・ゲストハウスの検索予約。当日セールも多いです。

yeogiBody.ko: 숙소 비교와 리뷰 확인에 좋습니다. 한국어 UI지만 사진·지도로도 고르기 쉽습니다.
yeogiBody.en: Easy stay comparison and reviews. Photos and maps help even if the UI is Korean.
yeogiBody.ja: 宿泊比較とレビュー確認に便利。写真と地図でも選びやすいです。

coupangBody.ko: 생필품·배달 음식. 외국인 카드 결제가 되는 경우가 많아 단기 체류에도 유용합니다.
coupangBody.en: Groceries and food delivery. Often accepts foreign cards — handy for short stays.
coupangBody.ja: 日用品やフード配達。海外カードが使えることも多く短期滞在にも便利です。

baeminBody.ko: 한국에서 가장 많이 쓰는 음식 배달 앱입니다. 한국어 UI지만 사진·지도로 메뉴를 고르기 쉽고, 단기 체류에도 숙소로 배달받기 좋습니다.
baeminBody.en: Korea’s most popular food delivery app. The UI is Korean, but photos and maps make ordering easy — great for hotel delivery on short trips.
baeminBody.ja: 韓国で最も使われるフードデリバリーアプリ。UIは韓国語ですが写真と地図で選びやすく、短期滞在の宿への配達にも便利です。

yogiyoBody.ko: 배민과 함께 자주 쓰는 배달 앱입니다. 가게·쿠폰이 다를 수 있어 둘 다 비교해 보면 좋아요.
yogiyoBody.en: Another major delivery app alongside Baemin. Shops and coupons differ — worth comparing both.
yogiyoBody.ja: ペミンと並ぶ主要な配達アプリ。店舗やクーポンが違うことがあるので両方比較するとお得です。

tmoneyBody.ko: 교통카드 잔액·충전, 따릉이 등 일부 교통 서비스를 앱에서 확인할 수 있습니다.
tmoneyBody.en: Check transit card balance/top-up and some mobility services in one app.
tmoneyBody.ja: 交通カード残高・チャージや一部モビリティをアプリで確認できます。
tmoneyBody.zh: 可在应用中查看交通卡余额·充值及部分出行服务。

kakaoTBody.ko: 택시·대리·바이크·주차 등 이동 서비스를 한 앱에서. 외국인 카드 결제도 지원하는 경우가 많습니다.
kakaoTBody.en: Taxis, designated drivers, bikes, and parking in one app. Foreign cards are often accepted.
kakaoTBody.ja: タクシー・代行・バイク・駐車など移動サービスを1つのアプリで。海外カード決済にも対応しやすいです。
kakaoTBody.zh: 出租车、代驾、单车、停车等出行服务集于一款应用，常支持境外银行卡支付。

festivals.title: Festivals & Events
festivals.intro: Check regional festivals and events on official tourism sites.
festivals.linkVisitKoreaDesc: Korea’s official festival hub — featured, themed, and regional events.
festivals.linkNationwideDesc: Browse ongoing and upcoming festivals by region and season.
festivals.linkKoreanVisitDesc: Official domestic travel portal from Korea Tourism Organization.
festivals.linkVisitKoreaEnDesc: Official Korea Tourism Organization site for international travelers.
festivals.sourceNote: Schedules can change — always confirm on the official sites linked above.

souvenir.maskDesc: Jaksim KF94, Bluedot, Aer — dust masks sold at pharmacies, convenience stores, Olive Young.
souvenir.stationeryDesc: Monami 153 pens, Iconic diaries, Kakao Friends sticky notes.
souvenir.oliveDesc: Dokdo toner, Anua Heartleaf, Mediheal masks — Olive Young bestsellers.
souvenir.daisoDesc: Cable ties, eco bags, toothpaste squeezers, Kakao Friends collabs.
souvenir.snackTitle: Pepero, Honey Butter Chips, Shrimp Crackers
souvenir.snackDesc: Pepero, Honey Butter Chips, Saewookkang, onion rings — mart/convenience classics.
souvenir.ramenDesc: Samyang Buldak, Nongshim Chapagetti, Neoguri, Shin Ramyun multipacks.
souvenir.teaDesc: CKJ ginseng sticks, yuja tea syrup, barley/corn tea bags.
souvenir.honeyDesc: Acacia honey, yuja honey, yakgwa/hangwa gift boxes.
souvenir.uniqloDesc: Korea-only colors and character collab tees are popular keepsakes.
souvenir.spaDesc: SPAO, 8Seconds, Uniqlo tees, pajamas, socks — value fashion.
souvenir.socksDesc: Shoopen, SPAO, Daiso 3-/5-pair sock and tights packs.
souvenir.hanbokDesc: Besides rentals, norigae charms, handkerchiefs, and mini keyrings sell well.
souvenir.sheetDesc: Mediheal N.M.F, numbuzin soothing pads, TIRTIR mask box sets.
souvenir.sunscreenDesc: Birch juice sunscreen, Tocobo sun stick, Green Finger kids SPF, etc.
souvenir.lipstickDesc: Juicy Lasting Tint, Peripera Ink Velvet, CLIO Kill Cover.
souvenir.kpopDesc: Tower Records, Hottracks, Weverse — official albums and merch.
souvenir.tapHint: Tap a card for where to buy and practical tips.
souvenir.maskBody1: Popular picks: Jaksim KF94, Bluedot, Aer KF94/KF80 packs (5–10 sheets) from convenience stores, Daiso, Olive Young, or pharmacies — easy suitcase size.
souvenir.maskBody2: For sanitizer, travel sizes (30–60ml) at Olive Young or store brands fit liquid limits better than large bottles. Neighborhood pharmacies often beat Myeongdong on stock/price in dust season.
souvenir.maskTip:
Buying tip

Check the KF94 mark and pack date. For bulk gifts, pharmacy multipacks are usually safest.
souvenir.stationeryBody1: Stationery hits: Monami 153 pen sets, Iconic/Qri diaries & stickers, Kakao Friends/BT21 washi & memos, Alpha notebooks — Daiso, Artbox, Olive Young, stationery shops.
souvenir.stationeryBody2: Artbox/Alpha often have limited collabs; stickers/memos are light for flights.
souvenir.stationeryTip:
Buying tip

Cased sets for gifts; refills/singles for yourself.
souvenir.oliveBody1: Top Olive Young picks for visitors: Round Lab Dokdo toner/cream, Anua Heartleaf 77, COSRX snail/BHA, Mediheal & numbuzin sheet masks. Start at ‘Olive Young Picks’ / sale walls.
souvenir.oliveBody2: Lips: rom&nd Juicy Lasting Tint, Peripera Ink Velvet. Hand cream: Illiyoon or Camell are better value than tiny prestige minis. Ask about tax-free before checkout.
souvenir.oliveTip:
Buying tip

Big Myeongdong/Hongdae/Gangnam stores have deeper stock than airport shops. Ask staff about app coupons and gift-with-purchase.
souvenir.daisoBody1: Visitor favorites: packing cubes/cable ties, silicone tongs, mini boards, toothpaste squeezers, Kakao Friends / Chiikawa / Sanrio stationery pouches — easy multipacks at fixed prices.
souvenir.daisoBody2: Ask for padding on glass/ceramics; use floor signs for Travel/Storage/Kitchen. Neighborhood stores are quieter than tourist branches.
souvenir.daisoTip:
Buying tip

Weigh your basket before checkout; prioritize gap-fillers for your suitcase.
souvenir.snackBody1: Gift staples: Lotte Pepero (almond/nude), Haitai Honey Butter Chips, Nongshim Saewookkang & onion rings, Orion Choco Pie & Potato chips. Hypermarket promo aisles often beat convenience multipacks.
souvenir.snackBody2: Jellies like Orion MyGummi and Lotte assortments are popular too. Chocolate Pepero can melt in summer — buy near departure or keep cool.
souvenir.snackTip:
Buying tip

Individually wrapped Pepero multipacks are easy to share. Watch suitcase volume for flight weight limits.
souvenir.ramenBody1: Top edible souvenirs: Samyang Buldak (original/carbonara/cheese), Nongshim Chapagetti, Neoguri, Shin Ramyun. Bag multipacks (5) beat cup noodles at marts/Daiso.
souvenir.ramenBody2: Add Hetbahn rice packs for easy meals at home. Double-bag soup packets so they don’t burst under pressure.
souvenir.ramenTip:
Buying tip

Check Emart/Homeplus promo aisles first; use convenience stores only to fill gaps.
souvenir.teaBody1: Gift teas: CheongKwanJang (KGC) ginseng sticks, Bokumjari/Goheung yuja syrup, barley & corn tea bags, Osulloc sets — department food halls, souvenir shops, airports.
souvenir.teaBody2: Liquid yuja syrup belongs in checked bags (or choose stick powders). Ask for gift wrap.
souvenir.teaTip:
Buying tip

Buy CheongKwanJang from official/large retailers to avoid counterfeits.
souvenir.honeyBody1: Sweet souvenirs: Korean acacia/chestnut honey, yuja-ginger syrups, yakgwa & hangwa boxes in Insadong, department stores, airports. Choose padded yakgwa boxes.
souvenir.honeyBody2: Honey rules differ by country — check customs. Prefer sticks/pouches over glass jars.
souvenir.honeyTip:
Buying tip

Sealed labeled jars with expiry dates beat open market bulk for gifts and customs.
souvenir.uniqloBody1: Even global SPA brands stock Korea-only colors, graphics, and character collabs. Limited tees are a common only-in-Korea buy.
souvenir.uniqloBody2: Seasonal sales are competitive, and tax-free flows are familiar. Always try sizes in the fitting room.
souvenir.uniqloTip: Large stores (Myeongdong, Times Square, COEX) have better stock. Use cm on the label — Korean sizing varies by brand.
souvenir.spaBody1: Value fashion: SPAO, 8Seconds, Uniqlo for tees, PJs, socks, umbrellas. SPAO character collabs drop each season.
souvenir.spaBody2: KR sizes can run small — size up if unsure and keep receipts.
souvenir.spaTip:
Buying tip

Compare Myeongdong/Hongdae/Gangnam shops; watch for sale seasons.
souvenir.socksBody1: Value socks/tights: Shoopen, SPAO, Uniqlo, Daiso 3–5 packs. Hanbok-style and character socks make easy gifts.
souvenir.socksBody2: Useful mid-trip spares — buy early. Check KR sizes (230–280) and prefer individually packed sets.
souvenir.socksTip:
Buying tip

3-/5-pair packs beat singles and fill suitcase gaps.
souvenir.hanbokBody1: Besides palace rental hanbok, modern hanbok-style tops, norigae charms, handkerchiefs, and mini keyrings make portable cultural souvenirs.
souvenir.hanbokBody2: Tourist-shop prices vary widely — compare Insadong, Tongin Market, and department-store traditional corners. Check fabric and stitching by hand.
souvenir.hanbokTip: Rent for photos; buy small accessories to take home. Full hanbok is bulky and wrinkles in a suitcase.
souvenir.sheetBody1: Gift-ready sheet masks: Mediheal N.M.F Aquaring, numbuzin No.1/3/5, TIRTIR masks/cushion minis, CNP Anti-Pore — frequent Olive Young / duty-free picks.
souvenir.sheetBody2: 10-sheet boxes look more gift-like than singles. Sensitive skin: check “centella / soothing” labels.
souvenir.sheetTip:
Buying tip

Prefer sets with clear expiry dates and English packaging for gifts.
souvenir.sunscreenBody1: Popular: Round Lab birch juice sunscreen, Tocobo cotton soft / sun sticks, Green Finger kids SPF, Hatage sun sticks — many travelers want low-white-cast gels/sticks.
souvenir.sunscreenBody2: Pick ≤50ml or stick formats for cabin liquids. Check mineral vs chemical labels; keep face and body products separate if needed.
souvenir.sunscreenTip:
Buying tip

Start with Olive Young Picks and mini kits in the sun-care aisle.
souvenir.lipstickBody1: Makeup souvenirs: rom&nd Juicy Lasting Tint / Glasting Gloss, Peripera Ink Velvet, CLIO Kill Cover cushion/foundation, Espoir Be Velvet — Olive Young fixtures.
souvenir.lipstickBody2: Swatch shades in-store. Everyday singles + mini lips often beat duty-free kits on value.
souvenir.lipstickTip:
Buying tip

Ask staff for mute/warm undertones. Mind tester hygiene and keep receipts for returns.
souvenir.kpopBody1: Safest K-pop souvenirs: official albums/photocards/slogans from Tower Records Seoul, Hottracks, Kyobo, and Weverse/Makestar pop-ups. Be wary of unofficial street merch.
souvenir.kpopBody2: Check sealed vs opened photocards; pack albums firmly. Tickets/light sticks only via official channels.
souvenir.kpopTip:
Buying tip

Scrutinize pricey second-hand photocards for authenticity.

maskBody.ko: 외국인 기념품·실사용으로 많이 사는 건 작심(Jaksim) KF94, 블루닷(Bluedot), 아에르(Aer) 같은 KF94/KF80 마스크입니다. 편의점·다이소·올리브영·약국에 소량 팩(5~10매)이 많아 캐리어에 넣기 좋습니다.
maskBody.en: Popular picks: Jaksim KF94, Bluedot, Aer KF94/KF80 packs (5–10 sheets) from convenience stores, Daiso, Olive Young, or pharmacies — easy suitcase size.
maskBody.ja: 人気はジャクシムKF94、Bluedot、AerなどのKF94/KF80。コンビニ・ダイソー・オリーブヤング・薬局の5〜10枚パックが荷物に入れやすいです。

maskBody.ko: 손소독제는 세타필·그린핑거 미니보다 편의점 PB나 올리브영 여행용(30~60ml)이 액체 제한에 맞습니다. 황사 시즌에는 명동보다 동네 약국이 재고·가격이 나은 경우가 많습니다.
maskBody.en: For sanitizer, travel sizes (30–60ml) at Olive Young or store brands fit liquid limits better than large bottles. Neighborhood pharmacies often beat Myeongdong on stock/price in dust season.
maskBody.ja: 消毒ジェルは30〜60mlのトラベルサイズが液体制限に合うことが多いです。黄砂の季節は明洞より近所の薬局が在庫・価格で有利なことも。

maskBody.ko:
구매 팁

‘KF94’ 표기와 포장 날짜를 확인하세요. 귀국용 대량 구매는 다이소·온라인보다 시중 약국 묶음이 무난합니다.
maskBody.en:
Buying tip

Check the KF94 mark and pack date. For bulk gifts, pharmacy multipacks are usually safest.
maskBody.ja:
買い方

KF94表示と包装日を確認。まとめ買いは薬局のマルチパックが無難です。

stationeryBody.ko: 문구 기념품으로는 모나미 153 볼펜 세트, 아이코닉·퀴리 다이어리/스티커, 카카오프렌즈·BT21 메모·마스킹테이프, 알파 노트·하이라이터 세트가 다이소·아트박스·올리브영·문구점에서 잘 나갑니다.
stationeryBody.en: Stationery hits: Monami 153 pen sets, Iconic/Qri diaries & stickers, Kakao Friends/BT21 washi & memos, Alpha notebooks — Daiso, Artbox, Olive Young, stationery shops.
stationeryBody.ja: モナミ153セット、Iconic手帳/シール、カカオ/BT21マスキング、Alphaノートなどがダイソーやアートボックスで人気。

stationeryBody.ko: 아트박스·알파·아이비스 매장에서 한정 콜라보를 찾기 좋고, 가벼운 스티커·메모는 항공 무게 부담이 적습니다.
stationeryBody.en: Artbox/Alpha often have limited collabs; stickers/memos are light for flights.
stationeryBody.ja: 限定コラボはアートボックス等が狙い目。シール類は軽くて土産向き。

stationeryBody.ko:
구매 팁

선물용은 케이스 세트, 본인용은 리필·단품이 합리적입니다.
stationeryBody.en:
Buying tip

Cased sets for gifts; refills/singles for yourself.
stationeryBody.ja:
買い方

贈り物はケースセット、自分用は単品が合理的。

oliveBody.ko: 올리브영에서 외국인이 가장 많이 집는 라인은 라운드랩(독도 토너·크림), 아누아(어성초 77 토너·세럼), 코스알엑스 스네일/BHA, 메디힐·넘버즈인 시트마스크입니다. ‘올영픽’·세일 진열을 먼저 보면 실패가 적습니다.
oliveBody.en: Top Olive Young picks for visitors: Round Lab Dokdo toner/cream, Anua Heartleaf 77, COSRX snail/BHA, Mediheal & numbuzin sheet masks. Start at ‘Olive Young Picks’ / sale walls.
oliveBody.ja: 人気はラウンドラボ（独島トナー等）、アヌア（ハートリーフ77）、COSRX、メディヒール/numbuzinシートマスク。「オールヨンプック」とセール棚から選ぶと失敗が少ないです。

oliveBody.ko: 립은 롬앤 쥬시 라스팅 틴트, 페리페라 잉크 벨벳이 스테디고, 핸드크림은 카밀·록시땅 미니보다 국산 일리윤·카밀 대용량이 가성비가 좋습니다. 택스프리 가능 매장인지 계산 전 확인하세요.
oliveBody.en: Lips: rom&nd Juicy Lasting Tint, Peripera Ink Velvet. Hand cream: Illiyoon or Camell are better value than tiny prestige minis. Ask about tax-free before checkout.
oliveBody.ja: リップはrom&nd、ペリペラが定番。ハンドクリームはイリユン等がコスパ良好。会計前にTAX FREE可否を確認。

oliveBody.ko:
구매 팁

명동·홍대·강남 대형점이 재고가 많고, 공항점은 품절이 잦습니다. 앱 쿠폰·증정품 조합을 직원에게 물어보세요.
oliveBody.en:
Buying tip

Big Myeongdong/Hongdae/Gangnam stores have deeper stock than airport shops. Ask staff about app coupons and gift-with-purchase.
oliveBody.ja:
買い方

明洞・弘大・江南の大型店が在庫豊富。空港店は欠品しがち。アプリクーポンも聞いてみて。

daisoBody.ko: 다이소에서 외국인이 많이 집는 건 여행용 압축백·케이블 타이, 실리콘 집게·미니 도마, 칫솔살균·치약짜개, 카카오프렌즈·치익·산리오 협업 문구·파우치입니다. 균일가라 부담 없이 여러 개 담기 좋습니다.
daisoBody.en: Visitor favorites: packing cubes/cable ties, silicone tongs, mini boards, toothpaste squeezers, Kakao Friends / Chiikawa / Sanrio stationery pouches — easy multipacks at fixed prices.
daisoBody.ja: 人気は圧縮袋・ケーブルタイ、シリコントング、ミニまな板、歯磨き粉絞り、カカオフレンズ/ちいかわ/サンリオ文具。均一価格でまとめ買いしやすいです。

daisoBody.ko: 깨지기 쉬운 유리·도자기는 포장재를 요청하고, 층별 안내판에서 ‘여행/수납/키친’을 찾으세요. 관광지점은 줄이 길 수 있어 저녁·주택가 지점이 한산합니다.
daisoBody.en: Ask for padding on glass/ceramics; use floor signs for Travel/Storage/Kitchen. Neighborhood stores are quieter than tourist branches.
daisoBody.ja: 割れ物は梱包を依頼。案内板で旅行/収納/キッチンを。観光地店は混雑しがち。

daisoBody.ko:
구매 팁

결제 전 무게를 재 보고, 캐리어 틈새용 소품 위주로 고르세요.
daisoBody.en:
Buying tip

Weigh your basket before checkout; prioritize gap-fillers for your suitcase.
daisoBody.ja:
買い方

会計前に重さを確認し、隙間に入る小物中心に。

snackBody.ko: 선물용 과자 정석은 롯데 빼빼로(아몬드·누드), 해태 허니버터칩, 농심 새우깡·양파링, Orion 초코파이·포카칩입니다. 홈플러스·이마트 행사 코너가 편의점보다 묶음이 저렴한 경우가 많습니다.
snackBody.en: Gift staples: Lotte Pepero (almond/nude), Haitai Honey Butter Chips, Nongshim Saewookkang & onion rings, Orion Choco Pie & Potato chips. Hypermarket promo aisles often beat convenience multipacks.
snackBody.ja: 定番はロッテペペロ、ヘテ・ハニーバターチップ、農心セウカン/玉ねぎリング、オリオンチョコパイ・ポカチップ。ホームプラス・イーマートのセールがコンビニよりお得なことが多いです。

snackBody.ko: 젤리는 오리온 마이구미, 롯데 젤리·하비비, 편의점 한정 디저트 푸딩도 인기입니다. 여름에는 초콜릿 빼빼로가 녹을 수 있어 아이스박스·출국 직전 구매를 권합니다.
snackBody.en: Jellies like Orion MyGummi and Lotte assortments are popular too. Chocolate Pepero can melt in summer — buy near departure or keep cool.
snackBody.ja: ゼリーはオリオンマイグミなども人気。夏はチョコペペロが溶けるので出発直前購入が安心。

snackBody.ko:
구매 팁

개별 포장 선물세트(빼빼로 멀티)를 고르면 나눠 주기 쉽습니다. 중량 제한이 있는 항공은 과자 부피를 미리 재세요.
snackBody.en:
Buying tip

Individually wrapped Pepero multipacks are easy to share. Watch suitcase volume for flight weight limits.
snackBody.ja:
買い方

個別包装のマルチパックが配りやすいです。荷物の体積にも注意。

ramenBody.ko: 식용 기념품 1위는 삼양 불닭볶음면(오리지널·카르보·치즈), 농심 짜파게티·너구리·신라면·육개장입니다. 컵라면보다 봉지 멀티팩(5개입)이 마트·다이소에서 저렴합니다.
ramenBody.en: Top edible souvenirs: Samyang Buldak (original/carbonara/cheese), Nongshim Chapagetti, Neoguri, Shin Ramyun. Bag multipacks (5) beat cup noodles at marts/Daiso.
ramenBody.ja: 定番は三養ブルダック（オリジナル/カルボ/チーズ）、農心チャパゲティ・ノグリ・辛ラーメン。カップより袋5個パックがマート/ダイソーで安いです。

ramenBody.ko: 햇반·컵반을 같이 사면 귀국 후 ‘한식 한 끼’가 됩니다. 국물 스프는 압력이 있는 짐에서 터질 수 있어 지퍼백에 한 번 더 넣으세요.
ramenBody.en: Add Hetbahn rice packs for easy meals at home. Double-bag soup packets so they don’t burst under pressure.
ramenBody.ja: ヘトバンご飯を足すと帰国後の韓食セットに。スープ粉はジッパー袋に二重包装を。

ramenBody.ko:
구매 팁

이마트·홈플러스 라면 특가 코너를 먼저 보고, 편의점은 보완용으로 쓰세요.
ramenBody.en:
Buying tip

Check Emart/Homeplus promo aisles first; use convenience stores only to fill gaps.
ramenBody.ja:
買い方

イーマート・ホームプラスの特価から見て、コンビニは補充用に。

teaBody.ko: 차·건강 선물로는 정관장(한국인삼공사) 홍삼 스틱, 복음자리·고흥 유자청, 동서·샘표 보리차·옥수수차 티백, 오설록 티백 세트가 백화점 식품관·기념품샵·공항에 많습니다.
teaBody.en: Gift teas: CheongKwanJang (KGC) ginseng sticks, Bokumjari/Goheung yuja syrup, barley & corn tea bags, Osulloc sets — department food halls, souvenir shops, airports.
teaBody.ja: 正官庄紅参スティック、柚子茶、麦茶/とうもろこし茶、オスルロクなどが百貨店食品売り場や空港に多いです。

teaBody.ko: 액체 유자청은 기내 수하물 제한에 걸리니 위탁 수하물로 넣거나 스틱형 분말을 고르세요. 선물 포장 무료 여부를 매장에 물어보면 좋습니다.
teaBody.en: Liquid yuja syrup belongs in checked bags (or choose stick powders). Ask for gift wrap.
teaBody.ja: 液体の柚子茶は預け荷物へ。スティック粉タイプも便利。ギフト包装を聞いてみて。

teaBody.ko:
구매 팁

정관장은 위조 방지를 위해 공식·대형 매장 구매를 권합니다.
teaBody.en:
Buying tip

Buy CheongKwanJang from official/large retailers to avoid counterfeits.
teaBody.ja:
買い方

正官庄は公式・大型店購入が安心です。

honeyBody.ko: 달콤한 기념품으로는 국산 아카시아·밤꿀, 유자·생강청, 전통 약과·한과·유과 선물세트가 인사동·백화점·공항에서 잘 팔립니다. 깨지기 쉬운 약과는 완충 포장 제품을 고르세요.
honeyBody.en: Sweet souvenirs: Korean acacia/chestnut honey, yuja-ginger syrups, yakgwa & hangwa boxes in Insadong, department stores, airports. Choose padded yakgwa boxes.
honeyBody.ja: アカシア/栗蜂蜜、柚子・生姜茶、薬菓・韓菓セットが仁寺洞や百貨店・空港で人気。割れやすい薬菓は緩衝包装を。

honeyBody.ko: 벌꿀은 항공 액체·농산물 검역 규정이 나라마다 다릅니다. 귀국 전 자국 세관 규칙을 확인하고, 소형 유리병보다 스틱·파우치를 권합니다.
honeyBody.en: Honey rules differ by country — check customs. Prefer sticks/pouches over glass jars.
honeyBody.ja: 蜂蜜は国ごとに持ち込み規制あり。スティック/パウチが安心。

honeyBody.ko:
구매 팁

시장 벌크보다 밀봉 라벨·유통기한이 있는 제품이 선물·검역에 유리합니다.
honeyBody.en:
Buying tip

Sealed labeled jars with expiry dates beat open market bulk for gifts and customs.
honeyBody.ja:
買い方

密封ラベルと期限表示のある製品を選びましょう。

uniqloBody.ko: 유니클로·갭·ZARA 등 글로벌 SPA라도 한국 매장에는 한정 컬러·그래픽·캐릭터 콜라보가 따로 나오는 경우가 있습니다. ‘여기서만 본 티셔츠’를 기념으로 사는 여행객이 많습니다.
uniqloBody.en: Even global SPA brands stock Korea-only colors, graphics, and character collabs. Limited tees are a common only-in-Korea buy.
uniqloBody.ja: グローバルSPAでも韓国限定カラーやコラボTが出ることがあります。「ここでしか見た服」をお土産にする人も多いです。

uniqloBody.ko: 시즌 세일 기간에는 가격 경쟁력이 좋고, 영수증·택스프리 절차도 비교적 익숙합니다. 피팅룸에서 사이즈를 꼭 확인해 두세요.
uniqloBody.en: Seasonal sales are competitive, and tax-free flows are familiar. Always try sizes in the fitting room.
uniqloBody.ja: セール時期は価格が魅力。免税手続きも比較的分かりやすいです。試着は必須。

uniqloBody.ko:
사는 팁

명동·타임스퀘어·코엑스 등 대형 매장이 재고가 넉넉합니다. 한국 사이즈는 브랜드마다 다르니 라벨의 cm를 기준으로 고르세요.
uniqloBody.en:
Buying tip

Large stores (Myeongdong, Times Square, COEX) have better stock. Use cm on the label — Korean sizing varies by brand.
uniqloBody.ja:
買うときのヒント

明洞・タイムスクエア・COEXなど大型店が在庫豊富。韓国サイズはブランド差があるのでcm表示を基準に。

spaBody.ko: 스파오·미쏘·에잇세컨즈·탑텐 같은 한국 SPA 브랜드는 트렌디한 캐주얼을 합리적인 가격에 살 수 있어, ‘옷도 사고 기념품도 된다’는 이유로 인기입니다.
spaBody.en: Korean SPA brands like Spao, Mixxo, 8Seconds, and Topten offer trendy casual wear at fair prices — clothing that doubles as a souvenir.
spaBody.ja: SPAOやMISSO、8Seconds、Toptenなど韓国SPAはトレンド感のある服が手頃。服そのものがお土産になります。

spaBody.ko: 캐릭터·예능·아이돌 콜라보 티셔츠와 계절 아우터가 잘 나갑니다. 얇은 옷 위주로 고르면 짐 무게를 덜 수 있습니다.
spaBody.en: Character, variety-show, and idol collab tees plus light outerwear sell well. Prefer thin pieces to save luggage weight.
spaBody.ja: キャラ・番組・アイドルコラボTや薄いアウターが人気。かさばらない薄い服が荷物に優しいです。

spaBody.ko:
사는 팁

홍대·명동·강남 스트리트에 매장이 몰려 있습니다. 교환·환불 정책을 사진으로 남겨 두면 귀국 후 문제가 줄습니다.
spaBody.en:
Buying tip

Stores cluster in Hongdae, Myeongdong, and Gangnam. Photo the return policy in case of issues after you fly home.
spaBody.ja:
買うときのヒント

弘大・明洞・江南に店舗が集まります。返品規定を写真に残しておくと安心です。

socksBody.ko: 양말·스타킹은 슈펜(Shoopen), 스파오, 유니클로, 다이소 묶음(3·5족)이 가성비가 좋습니다. 한복 버선 스타일·캐릭터 양말도 선물용으로 잘 나갑니다.
socksBody.en: Value socks/tights: Shoopen, SPAO, Uniqlo, Daiso 3–5 packs. Hanbok-style and character socks make easy gifts.
socksBody.ja: Shoopen、SPAO、ユニクロ、ダイソーのまとめ買いがコスパ良好。韓服風・キャラ靴下も土産に人気。

socksBody.ko: 여행 중 여분으로 쓰기에도 좋아 출국 초반에 사 두는 사람이 많습니다. 사이즈(한국 230–280)를 확인하고 개별 포장 세트를 고르세요.
socksBody.en: Useful mid-trip spares — buy early. Check KR sizes (230–280) and prefer individually packed sets.
socksBody.ja: 旅の予備にも。韓国サイズ(230–280)と個別包装を確認。

socksBody.ko:
구매 팁

3·5족 팩이 낱개보다 저렴하고 캐리어 틈에 잘 들어갑니다.
socksBody.en:
Buying tip

3-/5-pair packs beat singles and fill suitcase gaps.
socksBody.ja:
買い方

3/5足パックが単品よりお得で隙間に入ります。

hanbokBody.ko: 고궁 한복 대여와 별개로, 생활한복 느낌의 저고리·블라우스, 노리개, 손수건, 미니 한복 키링 같은 소품 기념품도 잘 팔립니다.
hanbokBody.en: Besides palace rental hanbok, modern hanbok-style tops, norigae charms, handkerchiefs, and mini keyrings make portable cultural souvenirs.
hanbokBody.ja: レンタル韓服以外に、生活韓服風トップス、ノリゲ、ハンカチ、ミニキーホルダーなど小物土産も人気です。

hanbokBody.ko: 관광지 기념품 가게 가격 편차가 크니, 인사동·통인시장·백화점 전통 코너를 비교해 보세요. 천 소재와 마감 상태를 손으로 확인해 보는 것이 좋습니다.
hanbokBody.en: Tourist-shop prices vary widely — compare Insadong, Tongin Market, and department-store traditional corners. Check fabric and stitching by hand.
hanbokBody.ja: 観光地は価格差が大きいので、仁寺洞・通仁市場・百貨店の伝統コーナーを比較を。生地と縫製を手で確認。

hanbokBody.ko:
사는 팁

체험 사진이 목적이면 대여, 가져갈 선물이면 소품이 현실적입니다. 대형 한복은 캐리어에 구김·부피 부담이 큽니다.
hanbokBody.en:
Buying tip

Rent for photos; buy small accessories to take home. Full hanbok is bulky and wrinkles in a suitcase.
hanbokBody.ja:
買うときのヒント

写真ならレンタル、持ち帰りなら小物が現実的。本格韓服はかさばりしわになりやすいです。

sheetBody.ko: 시트마스크 선물로는 메디힐 N.M.F 아쿠아링, 넘버즈인(numbuzin) 1·3·5번, 티르티르(TIRTIR) 마스크·쿠션 미니, CNP 차앤박 안티포어가 올리브영·면세에서 자주 추천됩니다.
sheetBody.en: Gift-ready sheet masks: Mediheal N.M.F Aquaring, numbuzin No.1/3/5, TIRTIR masks/cushion minis, CNP Anti-Pore — frequent Olive Young / duty-free picks.
sheetBody.ja: 定番はメディヒールN.M.F、numbuzin、TIRTIR、CNPなど。オリーブヤングや免税でよく勧められます。

sheetBody.ko: 박스 세트(10매)가 낱개보다 기념품으로 보기 좋고, 면세·올리브영 세트가 구성이 명확합니다. 민감 피부는 ‘저자극·센텔라’ 표기를 확인하세요.
sheetBody.en: 10-sheet boxes look more gift-like than singles. Sensitive skin: check “centella / soothing” labels.
sheetBody.ja: 10枚ボックスが贈り物映えします。敏感肌は鎮静・センテラ表示を確認。

sheetBody.ko:
구매 팁

유통기한·언어 설명(영문)이 있는 수출용 세트가 선물용으로 안전합니다.
sheetBody.en:
Buying tip

Prefer sets with clear expiry dates and English packaging for gifts.
sheetBody.ja:
買い方

賞味(使用)期限と英語表示があるセットが安心です。

sunscreenBody.ko: 선케어 인기작은 라운드랩 자작나무 수분 선크림, 토코보(Tocobo) 코튼소프트·선스틱, 이소이·그린핑거 키즈 선, 헤지스 선스틱입니다. 백탁 적은 젤/스틱을 찾는 여행객이 많습니다.
sunscreenBody.en: Popular: Round Lab birch juice sunscreen, Tocobo cotton soft / sun sticks, Green Finger kids SPF, Hatage sun sticks — many travelers want low-white-cast gels/sticks.
sunscreenBody.ja: 人気はラウンドラボ白樺サンク、Tocoboスティック、グリーンフィンガー子ども用など。白浮きしにくいジェル/スティックが好まれます。

sunscreenBody.ko: 항공 액체 제한 때문에 50ml 이하·스틱형을 고르면 기내 반입이 수월합니다. ‘무기자차/유기자차’ 표기를 확인하고, 얼굴용·바디용을 나누는 편이 좋습니다.
sunscreenBody.en: Pick ≤50ml or stick formats for cabin liquids. Check mineral vs chemical labels; keep face and body products separate if needed.
sunscreenBody.ja: 機内持ち込みは50ml以下やスティックが楽。顔用・体用を分けると便利。

sunscreenBody.ko:
구매 팁

올리브영 선케어 코너의 ‘올영픽’과 미니 키트를 먼저 보세요.
sunscreenBody.en:
Buying tip

Start with Olive Young Picks and mini kits in the sun-care aisle.
sunscreenBody.ja:
買い方

オリーブヤングのサンケア「オールヨンプック」とミニキットから。

lipstickBody.ko: 립·메이크업 기념품으로는 롬앤(rom&nd) 쥬시 라스팅 틴트·글래스팅 글로스, 페리페라 잉크 벨벳, 클리오 킬커버 파운데이션/쿠션, 에스쁘아 비벨벳이 올리브영 고정 베스트입니다.
lipstickBody.en: Makeup souvenirs: rom&nd Juicy Lasting Tint / Glasting Gloss, Peripera Ink Velvet, CLIO Kill Cover cushion/foundation, Espoir Be Velvet — Olive Young fixtures.
lipstickBody.ja: 定番はrom&ndティント/グロス、ペリペラ、CLIOキルカバー、エスプアなどオリーブヤングの売れ筋。

lipstickBody.ko: 색번호는 매장 테스터로 확인하세요. 면세 한정 세트보다 시중 단품+미니 립 조합이 가성비가 좋은 경우가 많습니다.
lipstickBody.en: Swatch shades in-store. Everyday singles + mini lips often beat duty-free kits on value.
lipstickBody.ja: 色はテスターで確認。免税セットより単品＋ミニの方がコスパ良いことも。

lipstickBody.ko:
구매 팁

피부톤 상담이 필요하면 직원에게 ‘뮤트/웜’을 말해 보세요. 영수증·테스터 위생에 주의.
lipstickBody.en:
Buying tip

Ask staff for mute/warm undertones. Mind tester hygiene and keep receipts for returns.
lipstickBody.ja:
買い方

イエベ/ブルベを伝えて相談を。テスター衛生とレシート保管を。

kpopBody.ko: 케이팝 기념품은 타워레코드(타워레코드 서울), 핫트랙스, 영풍문고·교보 핫트랙스, 공식 위버스/메이크스타 팝업에서 사는 정규 앨범·포토카드·슬로건이 안전합니다. 길거리 비공식 굿즈는 품질·저작권을 주의하세요.
kpopBody.en: Safest K-pop souvenirs: official albums/photocards/slogans from Tower Records Seoul, Hottracks, Kyobo, and Weverse/Makestar pop-ups. Be wary of unofficial street merch.
kpopBody.ja: 公式アルバム/トレカはタワーレコードソウル、Hottracks、教保、Weverse等で。路上の非公式グッズは注意。

kpopBody.ko: 한정 포토카드는 개봉 여부를 확인하고, 항공 짐에는 앨범을 단단히 고정하세요. 콘서트 티켓·응원봉은 공식 채널만 이용합니다.
kpopBody.en: Check sealed vs opened photocards; pack albums firmly. Tickets/light sticks only via official channels.
kpopBody.ja: トレカの開封有無を確認し、アルバムは荷物で固定。チケット/ペンライトは公式のみ。

kpopBody.ko:
구매 팁

시세가 비싼 중고 포카는 정품 여부를 신중히 보세요.
kpopBody.en:
Buying tip

Scrutinize pricey second-hand photocards for authenticity.
kpopBody.ja:
買い方

高額中古トレカは真贋を慎重に。

convenience.intro: Korean convenience-store ‘honey combos’ went viral on SNS and TV. Most need only a microwave.
convenience.c1Desc: Mix Chapagetti jjajang cup + spicy jjamppong cup
convenience.c2Desc: Cup tteokbokki + spaghetti ramyeon + sausage + cheese
convenience.c3Desc: Carbonara Buldak noodles + tuna-mayo triangle kimbap
convenience.c5Desc: Kaguri curry udon + grilled chicken + cheese
convenience.c6Desc: Dip Melona ice cream in iced coffee
convenience.c1_lead: The classic convenience-store drink hack. Mixing sweet banana milk with bitter coffee turns it into a dessert drink.
convenience.c1_products: Binggrae banana milk (or similar) · iced Americano (cup/can) from CU/GS25/7-Eleven · optional straw
convenience.c1_s1: Pick chilled banana milk and an iced Americano (or canned Americano).
convenience.c1_s2: Pour coffee into the banana milk little by little — start with 1/3 to 1/2 and adjust to taste.
convenience.c1_s3: Shake or stir. Add more coffee if too sweet, keep more milk if too bitter.
convenience.c1_tip: You can also pour banana milk into the coffee cup. Choose low-fat banana milk if you want it lighter.
convenience.c2_lead: A reliable light meal. Triangle kimbap comes in many fillings — pick your favorite.
convenience.c2_products: Triangle kimbap (tuna mayo, kimchi, spicy, etc.) · banana milk · optional wet wipes
convenience.c2_s1: Peel the wrapper following the 1 → 2 → 3 marks. Open just before eating so the seaweed stays crisp.
convenience.c2_s2: Bite so seaweed, rice, and filling come together; sip banana milk between bites.
convenience.c2_s3: Spicy fillings pair especially well with the sweet milk. Add an egg or hot bar if you want more.
convenience.c2_tip: Popular fillings sell out morning/late night. Check the expiry date and only microwave labeled products.
convenience.c3_lead: A popular upgrade that makes cup noodles much more filling — especially with spicy noodles.
convenience.c3_products: Cup ramyeon · boiled egg · 1 slice of cheese · chopsticks and hot water
convenience.c3_s1: Add hot water and wait as directed (use less water for stir-fry style noodles).
convenience.c3_s2: Add halved egg and a cheese slice on top; cover briefly so the cheese melts.
convenience.c3_s3: Stir lightly so the cheese melts into the broth, then eat right away.
convenience.c3_tip: Some eggs can be warmed in the store microwave. Watch for spills.
convenience.c4_lead: Crispy honey cookies with bitter coffee — a Korean tea-time combo from the convenience store.
convenience.c4_products: Yakgwa (individually wrapped or mini) · iced/hot Americano or latte
convenience.c4_s1: Open the yakgwa carefully — it can crumble.
convenience.c4_s2: Alternate bites of yakgwa with sips of coffee.
convenience.c4_s3: Latte for sweeter pairing, Americano for a cleaner finish.
convenience.c4_tip: Yakgwa is rich in oil and sugar — check the date and don’t leave it in heat too long.
convenience.c5_lead: Easy ‘chimaek’ vibes at your stay. Heat per package directions.
convenience.c5_products: Convenience fried/seasoned chicken · beer or non-alcoholic beer · optional pickles and wipes
convenience.c5_s1: Follow microwave wattage/time on the package (and thawing steps if frozen).
convenience.c5_s2: For crispier texture, vent the cover briefly or use an air fryer if available.
convenience.c5_s3: Eat with beer right away. Keep wipes ready for saucy chicken.
convenience.c5_tip: Alcohol purchase has age limits. Respect lodging rules for smell and trash sorting.
convenience.c6_lead: Dip Melona into coffee (or eat them together) for a sweet dessert — a summer photo favorite.
convenience.c6_products: Melona bar · iced Americano or unsweetened iced coffee · optional straw
convenience.c6_s1: Unwrap Melona and open the iced coffee lid.
convenience.c6_s2: Dip the tip of the Melona into the coffee and eat as it melts.
convenience.c6_s3: If it melts too fast, alternate bites outdoors in the shade.
convenience.c6_tip: It’s quite sweet — best as a dessert. Melona melts quickly in heat.

convenience.gongganchun_products: 1 Chapagetti/jjajang cup, 1 spicy seafood jjamppong cup. Optional cheese/egg.
convenience.gongganchun_s1: Cook both noodles (use about one cup of water total in a larger bowl if needed).
convenience.gongganchun_s3: Add water if too salty; more jjamppong powder if you want more heat.
convenience.gongganchun_tip: Brand names vary — any jjajang cup + jjamppong cup works.
convenience.markjeongsik_lead: Viral fan recipe: cup tteokbokki with spaghetti ramyeon, sausage, and cheese.
convenience.markjeongsik_products: Cup tteokbokki, spaghetti-style cup noodles, sausage, 1–2 cheese slices.
convenience.markjeongsik_s1: Heat tteokbokki and cook spaghetti noodles.
convenience.markjeongsik_s2: Combine noodles in the tteokbokki cup; add sausage and cheese.
convenience.markjeongsik_s3: Microwave 20–40s to melt cheese, then mix.

convenience.carbonara_lead: Mix Carbonara Buldak with tuna-mayo kimbap rice for a creamy ‘risotto’.
convenience.carbonara_products: Carbonara Buldak noodles, tuna-mayo triangle kimbap. Optional cheese/milk.
convenience.carbonara_s2: Unwrap kimbap and add the rice to the noodles.
convenience.carbonara_s3: Mix into a risotto texture; add cheese/milk if dry.
convenience.carbonara_tip: Too spicy? Add more rice or use less chili powder.
convenience.eolbaksa_lead: Ice cup + Bacchus energy drink + lemon-lime soda — a refreshing pick-me-up.
